question: For each building that is an academic building, what is the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of its rooms, and what is the building's full name and postal code? Only include buildings whose name is not "Ashdown House". Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  a.POSTAL_CODE,
  STDDEV(r.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(r.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation
FROM FCLT_BUILDING b
JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC'
  AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'Ashdown House'
GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE
